comment: Input index 2 is SOURCELVL_INPUT, declared but never given a widget, so it cannot be clicked and gets no line, no tag and no props. The PAN CV range is given as ±5V because that is the middle of the three the menu offers. The track menu has no 'Detect tempo and set bpm' item here, which the manual says is on sickoLooper1 only. The bar display is a custom widget with no ParamWidget, so the track menu it carries cannot be reached by clicking it for help; the same items are on the module's own menu under Track settings.
